title: Sync prep — backlog + growth journal (Amelia Soto)
body:
Context: quick prep for 1:1 with Raj (IC – infra team lead candidate for next rotation). Goal: unblock his roadmap priorities, align on career experiments, and clear the short-term backlog so demo work for Q1 isn't at risk.

Agenda (30m total)
- 0–5m: personal check-in (energy, focus, any immediate risk) — quick mood + one thing off my mind
- 5–12m: backlog triage — surface top 3 tickets blocking demo readiness (we have two infra P1s + one doc gap)
- 12–22m: growth experiments — proposal for 8-week craft project (A/B KV cache policy) + mentoring plan
- 22–28m: decisions & priorities (agree owners, cut scope if needed)
- 28–30m: ops & follow-ups (meeting clashes, time off, sync cadence)

Prep notes / prompts to use live
- "What's the one thing that, if you got done this week, would make you feel the most unstuck?"
- "Do you feel this demo is blocked by tech debt or by resourcing?"
- "Which area do you want me to provide coaching on this cycle? (architecture, influence, hiring)"

Backlog triage — tickets to call out
- ENG-4423: prefix cache eviction bug (Raj owns) — impact: demo latency spikes when seq len > 1k. Proposed quick mitigation: cap prefix cache growth to 48MB per session (temporary).
- ENG-4581: deployment graph flakes on dedicated nodes (SRE investigating) — need Raj to prioritize a postmortem and owner handoff.
- DOC-199: developer onboarding for private deployment (missing troubleshooting steps for KMS) — lower priority but useful for demo rehearsals.

Desired outcomes for backlog segment
- Decide fast mitigation for ENG-4423 (try cap policy) -> if Raj agrees, schedule patch + canary for Tue 2027-11-30.
- Confirm PM/SRE owner for ENG-4581 postmortem; if no one steps up, Raj to run the first draft.

Growth experiments (brainstorm sketch)
- Experiment idea: KV-cache A/B by session-size bucket. 2 arms: (A) aggressive retention (higher hit rate, more memory) vs (B) conservative retention (lower memory, more re-compute). Measure: p50/p95 latency, tokens/kg, and cost delta. Hypothesis: small sequences (<512) get no benefit; medium sequences (512–2k) see most upside.
- Duration: 6–8 weeks, start with internal synthetic benchmark -> limited canary -> broader traffic.
- Mentoring plan: weekly pairing on experiment design + one async write-up (Raj authors, I review). Goal: stretch on product-facing experiments and system-level telemetry.

Career canvas (quick notes to revisit)
- Raj wants to get better at cross-team influence (esp. with product & SRE). Action: run a 1:1 mock stakeholder mtg next week (roleplay).
- Discuss promotion readiness signals: impact breadth, system ownership, mentoring. Capture 3 examples for next 1:1.

Open questions / talking points to surface
- Is Raj interested in owning the on-call rotation for Dedicated nodes temporarily to surface infra gaps? (I should calibrate load before asking)
- Does he prefer concrete deliverables or exploratory spikes for growth time?

Follow-ups / action items (populate during meeting)
- AI-1: Patch ENG-4423 with cap policy and write short test case (owner: Raj, due: 2027-11-30).
- AI-2: Draft postmortem template for ENG-4581 and tag SRE (owner: Amelia, due: 2027-12-02).
- AI-3: Create experiment plan doc for KV-cache A/B and share with Research (owner: Raj, due: 2027-12-07).
- AI-4: Schedule mock stakeholder roleplay (owner: Amelia, due: 2027-12-01).

Notes-to-self (after meeting)
- If Raj pushes back on on-call ask, offer a 4-week shadow instead.
- Push for measurable success criteria on the experiment (define which dashboards + alert thresholds).
- Check license/infra cost estimate with finance before wider rollout.

Quick links to bring up in meeting
- Perf dashboard: /dashboards/kv-cache-usage (ask Raj to point to the p95 anomaly on Nov 18)
- PR: serving-runtime/pull/981 (context for eviction code)
- Confluence draft: platform/kv-cache-ab-test-notes (use to capture experiment plan)

Tone & meeting style reminder (manager -> me)
- Keep curious, limit advice to one concrete suggestion, push for ownership decisions in the room. If we don't decide, pick a default and set a short review window.

Quick calendar logistics
- Meeting length: 30m, blocking 45m in case of overflow. If overflow, move deep-technical work to separate triage.
- Raj time off: Dec 20–24 (confirm).

End-of-doc checklist (post 1:1)
- Update this file with AI assignments (copy to team tracker).
- Ping SRE/PM about postmortem owner.
- Add experiment plan to confluence and link in team Slack channel.

Random scratch ideas (don't need to surface unless time)
- Small recognition: call out the infra e2e load test he ran last month (good example for promotion narrative).
- Consider asking Raj to run a short brown-bag on cache strategies (good visibility + low lift).

---
Last update notes (meta): drafted 2027-11-25 while prepping for Friday sync; tuned phrasing after quick async with Raj on 2027-11-26.
